prompt.description: The task/instructions given to the spawned sub-agent. This is the sub-agent's only task -- it runs once and returns its output.

role.description: Optional role/persona for the spawned sub-agent, e.g. 'Research Analyst'. Defaults to 'Assistant'.

goal.description: Optional goal for the spawned sub-agent. Defaults to a goal derived from 'prompt'.

backstory.description: Optional backstory for the spawned sub-agent. Defaults to a short generic backstory.

expected_output.description: Optional description of the expected output format. Defaults to a generic description.

llm_config_id.description: Optional LLM config ID to override the model used for this specific spawn. If omitted, falls back to the 'default_llm_config_id' set in the tool configuration.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the calls needed to spawn and run the sub-agent (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://djangoapp:8000/api. Optional -- if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://djangoapp:8000/api.

default_llm_config_id.description: Default LLM config ID used to run the spawned sub-agent when the agent doesn't supply 'llm_config_id'. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

poll_timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the spawned sub-agent to finish before giving up. Optional, default 300.
